title: Miguel Ángel Félix Gallardo, founder of Mexico's Guadalajara cartel, dies at 80
dek: He was jailed since 1989 for his part in the 1985 murder of a US drug agent. His network is the root of much of modern Mexican drug trafficking.
what: On Sunday 15 November 2026 the pop culture account Pop Base posted that Miguel Ángel Félix Gallardo had died at 80. The post gave no source.

CP24 reports that the Jalisco state security ministry confirmed the death on 15 November. It says he died in a hospital of multiple organ failure, two days after he was moved there from prison for emergency care. CP24 describes him as a founder of the Guadalajara cartel, from which the Sinaloa cartel later emerged, and says he had been imprisoned since 1989. It says he was convicted over the 1985 killing of US Drug Enforcement Administration agent Enrique "Kiki" Camarena.
I did not find the ministry's own statement. The details above rest on press reports of it.
why: He is a figure from the first era of the Mexican drug trade, and many readers know him from television drama rather than from the record.
next: Official statements on where he will be buried and on his estate, if any are issued.
